Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.
Card Q&A.q: I activated this card's [When Digivolving] effect, and when my opponent's Digimon would leave the battle area for the 1st process, an immediate-type effect such as a "when [...] would leave" effect caused this card to be removed from the battle area. Can I then process the rest of this effect?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. You must play the specified cards for this card's [All Turns] effect whenever possible.
Card Q&A.q: 1 [BlitzGreymon] and 1 [CresGarurumon] are in this card's digivolution cards. Can I use this card's [All Turns] effect to play just [BlitzGreymon] from this Digimon's digivolution cards?
